root_causes: The earlier targeted audit failures were caused by VizieR response parsing assumptions; the corrected parser now successfully validates the ID/Seq crosswalk and compares all 17 requested objects.
The 17 residual IDs are directly verified absent from the frozen Zenodo membership, but this does not explain the other 11,585 excess candidates.
The scientific cause of the full 11,602 candidate excess is not yet proven.

The raw CDS Table 2 and Table 4 files match the corresponding publisher MRT records row by row, and the full 730,184-object Table 4 crosswalk to Table 2 Seq is exact; identifier mapping is not the cause of the 11,602 candidate-only residuals.

For the retained historical inputs, intersecting the 741,786 two-band SNR candidate set with the 730,239-object four-field-positive Table 2 set yields exactly the 730,184 Table 4 members. The four-field set alone admits 55 nonmembers. This is an empirical conjunction, not proof of the authors' published rule.
The 55 four-field-only controls lack per-object photometry/SNR diagnostics in the retained artifact, so the exact per-band detection failure is unknown.
The current PR branch has not freshly re-derived the 741,786 candidate set from the full light-curve archives.

The 55 four-field-only controls have substantial Table 2 detection counts and high median R2 values, but their per-epoch light-curve SNR traces are absent from the retained historical artifact. Catalog-level Ng/Nr and R2 cannot identify which band-specific SNR threshold excluded them.

The current production derivation's first metadata gate (both mean magnitudes) matches the historical 730,201-object intermediate set, but leaves 17 objects with one missing per-band period. A further Per-g/Per-r gate reproduces Table 4 exactly on archived inputs, but author-intent evidence is not yet established.

findings: A failed ID crosswalk can arise before any membership comparison; the audit must validate its parsed schema before reporting per-object membership.
A successful Zenodo checksum verifies downloaded bytes, not the correctness of the object-level crosswalk or scientific interpretation.
The reconstruction and production scientific gates must remain blocked until full membership and provenance evidence are independently verified.
A raw Table 4 object-level reference exists in Chan et al. (2022), CDS J/ApJ/932/118; it must not be confused with Chen et al. (2020) Table 4, which is an aggregate purity comparison.
The raw Table 4 ID equals the original CPVS Table 2 Seq for all 730,184 rows after the ZTF-name crosswalk.
The exact historical set relation C ∩ F = P is reproducible, but F alone has 55 false positives and must not be promoted to the production selector without author-method evidence.
A diagnostic sample should explicitly include the 55 four-field-only controls; the fixed 1,000-object sample now includes all 55.
